protocolMetadata.instructions: Use list tools to find records and their IDs before calling get or update tools. Use limit and offset to page through lists; pagination.has_more and pagination.next_offset identify the next page. Choose response_format=json for JSON text; structuredContent contains the result in either format. Affiliate Finder starts credit-consuming searches; Discovery Agents search continuously and deliver matches for review. Check the tool description and the user's intent before mutations, especially commission, payout, fraud, and delete actions. Access follows the authenticated team's permissions.

tool.name: affonso_list_affiliates
tool.title: List affiliates
tool.description: List affiliates with pagination, filtering, and sorting. Supports searching by name, email, or tracking ID, filtering by partnership status, group, or tag IDs (OR), and date range filters. Returns data with the affiliate ID, contact details, tracking_id, partnership_status, onboarding state, group, integration metadata, and timestamps. Pagination reports total, count, offset, limit, has_more, and next_offset when another page exists.
